from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper: its title and citation relationships with OTHER provided papers."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of this paper")
    references_other_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that appear in this paper's bibliography/reference list")
    cited_by_other_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that cite this paper in their references")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
